records.scope_rationale: The proposal defines a very large electrical load as at least 100 MW, requires vendors to report such sales separately, and distributes the resulting sales-tax revenues to a local-government account. The operative change is revenue distribution and vendor tax reporting, not a facility or utility-service condition or an infrastructure incentive. A qualifying data center could be a customer but that does not change the rule’s object. Scope membership only; no determination of enactment, present legal force, unique-instrument identity, or complete freshness.
